chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 119: Ji Ning Turns Attrition into Victory Over the Giant Tongyu
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning realizes he can't overpower the giant Tongyu. He shifts strategy, using his Rainwater Sword Domain to trap the giant in an inescapable web, forcing him to burn through his Divine Power or die.
og_title: The Web Tightens: Ji Ning's Brilliant Attrition Trap
og_description: Tongyu's giant form is unstoppable, but cannot be sustained. Ji Ning switches tactics, using a web of rain and lotuses to systematically bleed his enemy dry of Divine Power.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 119: The War of Attrition
twitter_description: Ji Ning can't beat the giant Tongyu in a brawl. So he traps him in a suffocating domain of rain and water lotuses, forcing him to exhaust his power or die.
